decisions.reason: This illuminated candle arch with sound extends a core product type the firm already masters, so its strong fit with existing craft knowledge and home-page prominence make withdrawal unlikely despite the added technical element.
The arched one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's established seasonal pyramid craftsmanship, giving it high absorptive fit and little reason to remove it quickly.

Although the electronic music box with interchangeable discs requires capabilities beyond traditional handcraft, it was highlighted as a flagship line and the firm is likely to keep it on the market to build and apply new knowledge rather than abandon it early.

As a complementary platform for the electronic music box, this product has a somewhat higher exit risk because it depends on the newer electronic line, but it still leverages the firm's design and accessory-making skills and supports learning around product C.

This Christmas motif platform is an accessory closely related to the firm's seasonal decorative strengths, so even with some dependence on the electronic music box ecosystem it is more likely to be retained than dropped.

The Christmas pyramid with Dresden theme sits squarely within the firm's traditional product and motif expertise, making it a highly compatible innovation with low probability of near-term withdrawal.
